bias.en: Bullish trend · at a record, overbought
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 处于纪录高位，超买

read.en: Palantir closed flat at $209.00 on Oct 12 after setting a new record of $212.94 intraday. It is up 10% in five sessions and 21% in 20, and above all its averages, all rising: 5-day ($200.6), 10-day ($194.5), 30-day ($184), 100-day ($155) and 200-day ($152). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 6 with a growing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Sep 21, and RSI is 76.
read.zh: Palantir 10月12日盘中创下 $212.94 新纪录后收平于 $209.00。五个交易日上涨 10%，20 个交易日上涨 21%，股价位于全部均线上方且均线均向上：5 日（$200.6）、10 日（$194.5）、30 日（$184）、100 日（$155）和 200 日（$152）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线上方且柱体放大，抛物线 SAR 自 9月21日起看多，RSI 为 76。

read.en: With RSI at 76 and price 14% above the 30-day average, the trend is strong but stretched, and the close well off the high hints at hesitation. A close above $213 targets $220 and then $230. Support is the 5-day average near $200.6 (Oct 8 high $204.4 above it), then $194.5 (10-day average, Sep 24 high) and SAR at $189.6.
read.zh: RSI 为 76，股价高于 30 日均线 14%，趋势强劲但已偏离较远，收盘明显低于高点显示多方迟疑。若收盘站上 $213，目标看 $220，再看 $230。支撑为约 $200.6 的 5 日均线（其上为 10月8日高点 $204.4），其次 $194.5（10 日均线、9月24日高点）及 $189.6 的 SAR。

r.zh: 整数关口；高盛新目标价
